reviews.comment: LOVED 320 with Butenko. He is so caring and truly wants everyone to succeed. He listens to student feedback and adjusts when possible. Class if flipped, so amazing video lectures at home, and practice problems in class. He has practice quizzes and exams which are VERY similar to the actual quizzes and exams that are graded. Everything is open note.

Take Dr. Butenko!! Flipped classroom, lots of opportunities to redeem your grade. Tests/quizzes are extremely fair and open notes, very similar to practices. He is super engaging, very accessible outside of class, and extremely helpful, understanding, and accommodating. I learned a lot in his class. I cannot stress enough, take this course!!

Overall, Professor Butenko is a very good professor. He made it clear what was on his exam. In order to succeed in his class you must practice the homeworks. Other than that, he breaks down and makes it clear how to solve the problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback
